fileAudio-bitrate.label: Bitrate
fileAudio-bitrate.tip: Audio bitrate - generally, higher = higher audio quality/file size

fileAudio-pan-box.label: Pan
fileAudio-pan-box.tip:
Affects volume placement from Left/Right channels
0%: L/R channel equalization
-100%: audio on Left only
+100%: audio on Right only

fileAudio-dry-box.label: Reverb - Dry
fileAudio-dry-box.tip: Dry reverb volume; lower indicates greater distance from sound origin

fileAudio-wet-box.label: Reverb - Wet
fileAudio-wet-box.tip: Wet reverb volume simulating closed space; higher indicates larger space
